text:
ravi_sales: quick sync - enterprise prospect needs an on-prem POC in a network-sealed DC. Key asks: chunked sideload (max 2GB chunks), COSE detached signatures, SBOM (they said SPDX), offline activation token flow, 48mo retention, and a line-item estimate for packaging + per-release validation. can we support and what are the constraints?

mina_se: yes, doable. we produce chunked artifacts + a chunk-manifest.json listing chunk filenames + sha256. we support SPDX 2.2 or CycloneDX; customer can pick. detached COSE signatures (COSE_Sign1) are produced per final bundle and per chunk if they want per-chunk verification.

jon_infra: agent 1.9 will reassemble and verify manifest automatically. default behavior: only final bundle is signed; per-chunk sigs add processing and time. chunking mode: streaming reassemble -> tar.gz -> verify signature -> validate SBOM.

alex_security: security notes: our default signing uses ECDSA P-256 (ES256). if they require HSM-backed signatures (customer-owned or ours), that's PS + monthly fee. cert/key rotation default: 90d; we can contract 180d or 360d for sealed environments but legal must sign an acceptance for increased risk and longer RTO.

ravi_sales: activation - do we require any egress?

mina_se: activation options:
- online: agent does ephemeral call to activation.redwood.ai over TLS (we can provide single IP/CIDR)
- offline: we generate a time-limited activation token signed by our signing key; customer pastes token into admin console or agent. token TTL default 7 days, can be extended in SOW.

legal_ops: pricing/legal: extended token TTL, extended cert rotations, and HSM work are billable. offline activation with hosted key escrow requires SLA + extra monitoring fees. we need explicit acceptance of delayed patching windows if they opt out of egress.

billing: rough numbers for proposal (ballpark): one-time packaging integration = $10k; per-release airgap validation = $750; quarterly maintenance bundle = $400/release; HSM signing setup = $8k one-time + $4k/mo if we host. will formalize after finance review.

mina_se: sample chunk-manifest snippet for them to show security team (trimmed):
{
  "bundle_id": "redwood-poc-2026-04-01",
  "chunks": [
    {"name": "bundle.part1.gz","sha256": "f1a2..."},
    {"name": "bundle.part2.gz","sha256": "9b3c..."}
  ],
  "final_bom_sha256": "d4e5...",
  "signature": "bundle.tar.gz.cose (detached)"
}

jon_infra: retention - default: deltas 6mo, full archives 18mo. customer asks 48mo -> possible but contractually required and storage fee applies (we bill archive storage monthly). also recommend they mirror final bundles to their on-prem immutable registry if they need longer local retention.

alex_security: attestation - we can include execution hashes and a notarized runbook attestation.json inside SBOM metadata. third-party notarization available as add-on.

ravi_sales: can we run upgrades entirely offline once the bundle is delivered?

mina_se: yes. agent supports offline apply and rollback. caveat: no egress = no automatic telemetry, no automated canary rollback triggers. we will include manual rollback runbook steps. also emergency hotfix path: customer can request an out-of-band signed hotfix; PS will validate and deliver.

deploy-bot: packaging checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/airgap-poc-checklist (SSO) :package:

legal_ops: include SOW clauses: acceptance of extended cert window, storage charges for >24mo retention, and liability limits for delayed patching.

ravi_sales: customer also asked about chunk integrity if one chunk corrupts during transfer. what's the behavior?

jon_infra: agent verifies per-chunk sha256 against manifest; if mismatch -> abort and surface which chunk failed. operator can re-transfer a single chunk and re-run assemble. we log hashes to local audit file.

billing: note: per-chunk revalidation during PS engagement is billable if we manage the transfer.

mina_se: action items: I'll draft a 1-page technical summary for their security reviewer with manifest example, activation flows, signature verification steps, and rollback mini-runbook. ETA 3h.

ravi_sales: i'll ask the customer whether they require HSM or just COSE ES256, and whether they can allow a single egress IP for activation. will loop legal for SOW amend. thanks team :thumbsup:
